concept.title: What does
concept.shortdesc: migrates a DITA map to MyST Markdown for Sphinx and proves that every topic arrived complete. The overview shows how the migration program is doing against its targets.

conbody.p: Teams moving from DITA to docs as code usually lose content without noticing: a conref that becomes a copy, a condition that disappears, an anchor that no longer exists. converts with , restores the reuse as MyST includes and substitutions, and then compares the result with DITA-OT's own HTML5 output of the source, topic by topic and build by build.

dlentry.dd: Content lost without appearing in the report. The target is 0.
Conrefs and key references that arrived as includes and substitutions.
Topics with no difference and nothing to review.
Mapping rules a writer has approved. Each one runs on every later map without the agent.
Broken links, navigation differences and old URLs that no longer resolve. The target is 0.
A model, not a measurement: topics passed without a writer multiplied by the minutes a manual check takes.
Cloud Run seconds and Gemini tokens at list price. Inside the free tier the bill is zero; the calculation is shown.
